Rat Caging

Rat caging systems

Lightweight and ergonomic rat caging is cage-wash free, recyclable, and delivered double-bagged, irradiated, and ready for use. Choose from 3 options that fit standard, tall and extra large housing requirements
  • BPA-free
  • Research-Ready
  • 100% PET
  • Recyclable

Rat Caging

Detailed Comparison

Specs Standard Rat Configuration (R-BTM-H) Tall Rat Configuration (R-BTM-H) Tall XL Rat Configuration (R-BTM-XL)
Sized for 2 rats 2 rats Large rats
Compatible rack Innorack IVC Rat & Innorack IVC Tall Rat Innorack IVC Rat & Innorack IVC Tall Rat Innorack Tall IVC Rat XL
Floor space 141 in² (909.7 cm²) 141 in² (909.7 cm²) 325.8 in² (2101.9 cm²)
Headroom 7" (18 cm) 7" (18 cm) 9" (22.9 cm)
Outside dims 17"L × 13.4"W (max)
43.2 cm L × 34.0 cm W (max)		 17"L x 13.4"W (max)
43.2 cm L x 34.0 cm W (max)		 16.9"L × 26.9"W (max)
42.9 cm L × 68.3 cm W (max)
Cage type Universal Euro Type III Universal Euro Type III Extra-large cage
Compatible lids RVX7, RVX8 RVX7, RVX8 RV7XL
Compatible feeder R-FEED-U, R-WIRE-TD R-FEED-U, R-WIRE-TD R-WIRE-TD, R-WIRE-XL
Water bottle R-WB-850 (acidified, chlorinated, ultra-pure) R-WB-850 (acidified, chlorinated, ultra-pure) R-WB-850 (acidified, chlorinated, ultra-pure
The autowatering option comes in a standard rat configuration and requires an Innorack IVC Rat, R-BTM-H-A bottom, RVX5 lid, R-FEED-U feeder.
